title: PreorderCommandsBookingFailedV1
description: 06 → saga signal (spec 11 §5.3, Inv-8): the spec-06 operation engine reached a terminal failure (compensated / failed_final / declined-alternatives) for a pre-order operation and, because the operation is marked IsPreorder, signals the saga instead of emitting the customer failure notification directly. On receipt the saga releases the reserved items (CommittingBooking → CompensatingItems → FailedFinal) and emits the one combined failure outcome. Routed to the 'preorder.processor' consumer; inbox-deduplicated and idempotent under duplicate delivery (Inv-5/Inv-9). Carries only opaque ids + a coarse reason (Inv-12) — the saga is resolved by operation_id, so no saga_id is required.

operation_id.description: Owning booking operation id; the saga is looked up by this.

reason.description: Coarse failure reason, e.g. 'compensated' | 'failed_final' | 'alternatives_declined' (never card data, Inv-12).

correlation_id.description: Correlation id propagated across the saga chain.
